result:
I have implemented the requested change to load pending script addons before dumping options at startup.

### Changes Made
1. **[main.py](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/mitmproxy/tools/main.py#L93-L99)**:
   - When `-s` is specified alongside `--options`, script addons are configured with `reload=True` by default, which defers script loading until the event loop runs. Because dumping options exits immediately prior to the event loop running `master.run()`, these scripts had not yet executed `loadscript()`.
   - Before calling `optmanager.dump_defaults(opts, sys.stdout)`, we now retrieve the [`ScriptLoader`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/mitmproxy/addons/script.py#L153) addon and invoke `s.loadscript()` on any pending [`Script`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/mitmproxy/addons/script.py#L77) instance where `s.ns is None`. This ensures their custom options and loader hooks run and are registered into `opts`.

2. **[custom_option.py](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/test/mitmproxy/data/addonscripts/custom_option.py)**:
   - Created a test addon script that registers a custom option (`custom_addon_option`) in its `load` hook.

3. **[test_main.py](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/mitmproxy-mitmproxy-flash-systematic-0/test/mitmproxy/tools/test_main.py#L35-L56)**:
   - Added `test_options_includes_addon_options` to verify that passing `-s custom_option.py --options` includes custom addon options in the dumped output.
   - Added `test_options_without_scripts` to ensure running `--options` without scripts continues to output default built-in options correctly without errors.
